hero_description: C.Zara Enterprise sells natural honey, cashew nuts, groundnuts, red palm oil, garri and ukwa to households and businesses in Abuja. Message or call and we will confirm today's price and delivery.
values_description: There is no online checkout. You tell us what you need and we sort out the rest with you directly.
feature_1_description: Tell us which products you want and how much.
feature_2_description: We reply with today's price, what is available and the delivery details.
feature_3_description: Not sure what you need or how much? Ask Florence before you order.
